exceptions.capability: HTTPS request to Bitbucket Cloud REST API gateway
exceptions.necessity: document the canonical Bitbucket Cloud REST base used by the access setup workflow.
exceptions.dataFlow: When the user authorizes a connection check, Test-BitbucketApiAccess.ps1 sends GET requests for the selected workspace repository list and optional pull-request metadata to api.bitbucket.org under /2.0; only status categories are returned and response bodies are suppressed.
exceptions.credentials: HTTP Basic authentication is assembled in memory from BITBUCKET_EMAIL and BITBUCKET_API_TOKEN read from the running process environment or an approved secret-store injection; the token must not appear in command-line arguments, files, logs, prompts, or responses.
exceptions.redirectControl: SKILL.md is documentation; actual authenticated requests are made by scripts/Test-BitbucketApiAccess.ps1. Test-BitbucketApiBase enforces HTTPS, exact api.bitbucket.org host, /2.0 path, and no user info/query/fragment. The validator sets -MaximumRedirection 0 for both Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7, normalizes every 3xx response as redirect-rejected, and fails closed without emitting credentials, Location, or request URI; tests/ApiAccessRedirect.Tests.ps1 verifies these controls.
exceptions.riskAssessment: Limited to user-authorized read-only validation; redirects are rejected fail closed and only redacted status/category/message data is emitted. Re-review is required if the host/base, request paths, credentials, scopes, or transport implementation changes.
exceptions.compensatingControls: Exact base validation, escaped workspace/repository identifiers, process-scoped secret preference, hidden token input, minimum read scopes, response-body suppression, Authorization cleanup, no-follow redirects, 3xx fail-closed normalization, redacted output, tests/ApiAccessRedirect.Tests.ps1 coverage, and fingerprint-bound review.

exceptions.capability: HTTPS request to Bitbucket Cloud REST API gateway
exceptions.necessity: document the exact Bitbucket REST base and in-memory Basic authentication boundary.
exceptions.dataFlow: scripts/Invoke-BitbucketReviewActions.ps1 sends GET requests for exact PR metadata, commits, comments, and tasks, and only after target/action authorization sends POST/PUT/DELETE review comment or task operations to api.bitbucket.org /2.0/repositories/{workspace}/{repository}/pullrequests/{id}; compact outcomes and credential-free receipts are retained.
exceptions.credentials: Basic authentication is assembled in memory from BITBUCKET_EMAIL and BITBUCKET_API_TOKEN read from the process environment or approved secret-store adapter; the exact BITBUCKET_API_BASE_URL is checked, and credentials never enter plan arguments, URLs, receipts, files, logs, or returned results.
exceptions.redirectControl: Assert-ApiUri in scripts/Invoke-BitbucketReviewActions.ps1 requires HTTPS, exact api.bitbucket.org:443, no user info or fragment, and the exact expected path; its HttpClientHandler sets AllowAutoRedirect = false. Pagination next links are revalidated and bounded before reuse.
exceptions.riskAssessment: Authenticated reads and explicitly authorized review mutations affect the selected PR; target drift, replay, redirects, ambiguous commit identity, and uncertain writes are fail-closed, and scope or endpoint expansion requires re-review.
exceptions.compensatingControls: Preview by default, exact target/action authorization, plan and commit validation, disabled redirects, bounded pagination/retries, read-after-write verification, credential-free receipts, redaction, least scopes, and fingerprint binding.
